name: Josee Robinson
role: Undergraduate Researcher, Psychology with a Chemistry minor
bio: Josee studies psychology on a pre-med concentration with a minor in chemistry, and intends to pursue medical school to specialise in psychiatry. She takes part in the Pre-Professional Society, Presidential Student Ambassadors, the Women Chemists Society, Psychology Academic Mentoring and the Honors Program, and volunteers at Our Lady of Lourdes.
